# Quantock Financial

> Quantock Financial is a trading name of Quantock Financial Services Ltd, a mortgage and protection advice firm at 1 The Crescent, Taunton, Somerset, TA1 4EA, United Kingdom. It offers whole of market, bespoke mortgage advice for first charge mortgages, plus personal protection and insurance advice. Quantock Financial Services Ltd is an appointed representative of The Openwork Partnership, a trading style of Openwork Limited which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority. Phone 01823 426046, email office@quantockfinancial.co.uk.

Key facts:
- Advisers: Neil Hudson BSc Cert II (MP), Director & Mortgage & Protection Adviser; William Hudson Cert II (MP), Mortgage & Protection Adviser; Claire Ratcliffe Cert II (MP&ER), Mortgage & Protection Adviser; Hattie Rogers CeMAP, Mortgage & Protection Adviser.
- Initial consultation is fee free. There may be a fee for arranging a mortgage, typically £399, depending on circumstances.
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm, Saturday 9am to 2pm, closed Sunday.
- Registered in England & Wales, company number 12383613.
- Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage.

## Mortgages
- [Mortgages overview](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/mortgages): Choosing a mortgage is about more than just the interest rate. It’s about finding the product that best fits your unique needs and goals.
- [Buy to let Mortgages](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/mortgages-buy-to-let): If you’re planning to buy a property to rent out, you’ll need a buy-to-let mortgage.
- [Moving House](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/mortgages-moving-house): Whether you’re moving to a bigger property or downsizing, we’re here to help you find the mortgage that best suits your new needs.
- [First-Time Buyer](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/mortgages-first-time-buyer): If you’re planning to buy your first home, you’ll likely need a mortgage: a loan that’s secured against the value of the property.
- [Later Life Lending](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/mortgages-later-life): A Lifetime Mortgage isn’t the right choice for everyone, and our qualified advisers are here to help you find out if it’s the right fit for your situation.
- [Remortgage](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/mortgages-remortgage): Remortgaging means switching your current mortgage to a new deal with a different lender, without having to move.

## Protection
- [Protection overview](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/protection): Personal protection is designed to provide financial support for the people who rely on you.
- [Life Insurance](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/insurance-life): Getting the right life insurance in place can be life changing, offering real peace of mind for you and financial security for your loved ones.
- [Critical Illness](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/protection-critical-illness): Critical Illness Cover (also known as Critical Illness Insurance) can help protect your finances if you’re diagnosed with a serious illness.
- [Family Income Benefit](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/protection-family-income-benefit): Family Income Benefit can help maintain your family’s financial stability if the worst should happen to you.
- [Income Protection](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/protection-income-protection): Income Protection Cover ensures your income is protected if illness or injury prevents you from working.

## Insurance
- [Insurance overview](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/insurance): Insurance is an important part of securing your financial future and taking care of the people you love.
- [Buildings and Contents](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/insurance-buildings-contents): You can choose to buy buildings and contents insurance separately or as a combined policy, depending on your needs. Homes are more than just structures.
- [Business Protection](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/insurance-business-protection): Most businesses depend on a small number of people. If an owner, director or key member of staff died or became seriously ill, the business could lose income, struggle to repay what it has borrowed, or be left unsure who owns it.

## About us
- [About Quantock Financial](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/about): Quantock Financial Services helps people make the best financial decisions possible.
- [What We Do](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/about-what-we-do): A product with the lowest rate isn’t always the right deal. Additional arrangement fees or a valuation to pay can make a mortgage much more expensive than one with a higher rate that has no fees.

## Client Area
- [Free Credit Report](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/client-area-free-credit-report): Before you make a decision about borrowing, you will need to check your credit report.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/client-area-mortgage-calculator): A quick and easy way to calculate your monthly mortgage payments.
- [Borrowing Calculator](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/client-area-borrowing-calculator): Most lenders will usually lend between 4.5 and 5 times your yearly income before tax.
- [Stamp Duty Calculator](https://quantockfinancial.co.uk/client-area-stamp-duty-calculator): You must pay Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) if you buy a property or land over a certain price in England and Northern Ireland.
